name: DDIM (alias of Euler)
plain: The name ddim does not have its own loop in core: the registry builds the Euler sampler with one extra inpaint option. The update is the same deterministic Euler line; only the noise used to re-noise the protected area of an inpaint mask differs. In σ coordinates Euler already has the η=0 DDIM form x'=(σ'/σ)x+(1−σ'/σ)D, so the name is not wrong, but no extra algorithm exists behind it.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
Same as Euler: x'=x+d·(σ'−σ).
Inpaint-only difference: KSamplerX0Inpaint gets a fresh noise tensor drawn on CPU with torch.manual_seed(seed+1), seed defaulting to 41, instead of the sampling noise tensor.

props.final_sigma0: Same as Euler: dt=−σ gives x'=D.

providers.author: Comfy Org and contributors
providers.note: Dispatches to sample_euler. A separate literal DDIM lives in VOID_DDIM.

label: from code
surprise: ddim runs sample_euler; only inpaint noise differs. The one literal DDIM loop in core is the VOID sampler.
